W15-74 (+W15B-18): moneyWords for every budget and estimate amount a person reads, and the UI's Money reads 'less than CHF 0.01' for a positive amount that rounds to CHF 0.00 (zero stays 'CHF 0.00'); the wrap-up and pause sentences are W15-16's, already done.

W15-65/W15-66/W15-78: a credential wait is said to 'start by itself' only where a wait is recorded; elsewhere the Start form ('Press Start and the work starts then'). W15-27 landed: the review_waits line stays as it is.
W15-67: the ready line reads the wait now (billing.waits.now, W15-22) as well as a recorded one, and names the wait and its time.
W15-86: the plan card's merged subscription line names up to three tasks then 'and N more'; one subject per sentence.
W15-43: whoName itself returns the person's word for a specialist (call sites unchanged); the budget card names the specialist in words.
W15B-10: the chip says paused tasks as paused, as the end line does ('Ended: 2 paused', 'Ended: 1 task needs you, 2 paused').

W15B-11: words only, no new button: the head-moved card's title names what happened ('"X" changed after the review') and its body names where each way out is ('... merge it yourself on GitHub, or redo the task from its row in Tasks.').
W15B-12: every merge left to the person counts on the Done line ('Done: all 2 tasks. 1 pull request waits for you.' with Open Overview); W15-108's built form (b) ('; 2 taken out') stays.
W15B-13: no UUID in text written on GitHub or in a refusal; every subject or grep marker code reads stays byte for byte.

W15B-14: the critic.verdict event carries the card kind (from loop/critic.ts's askedPerson) and the review-only pass one line of its own (a payload or event emitted in runner.ts); the session result's 'Did 1 task' for a review alone stays (the task became done in this session).
W15B-15: no raw level word on screen; the tone stays by colour, with an accessible name in words.

W15B-16: a yes/no setting reads 'on'/'off'; the session budget's 0 refusal says what to do; the fake daemon's budget sentences equal the daemon's. Owner question W15-109 untouched (0 stays refused for a session and for the month).
W15B-17: only what is shown is plain; the answer sent keeps the question as asked.
root_causes: packages/runtime/src/daemon/task-words.ts, task-display.ts, cancel-words.ts and request-words.ts: a paused task's lines and card are built without knowing whether its run wrote anything; the budget card quotes the model's text as given; a left-open card has no title for a head that moved.

packages/runtime/src/daemon/views.ts, event-lines.ts, session/stop-words.ts and apps/ui SessionPage.tsx: log lines quote raw outcomes, report text, level names and a measure against the wrong estimate; the chip counts a pause as 'needs you'; the critic's lines lack the card kind and the review-only pass.

packages/runtime/src/session/credential-wait.ts, start-blocked.ts, compose.ts's chooser line and project-status.ts: a credential wait is said to start by itself where no wait is kept; the project line reads neither the wait now nor every merge left to the person.

Money and names: budget and estimate amounts formatted without moneyWords, the UI's Money with no sub-centime case; whoName and the budget card print the registry key; the plan card's line names no task and its total sums unrounded figures; commit and intake texts carry UUIDs; settings print raw booleans.
UI pages and one capability sentence written before design §5's review (zero counts, a long card body from a whole report, raw markdown in question labels, a guide sentence about the copy).
areas.fix_scope: Base 3600089 (wave 15 run A merged: w15-merge, w15-run, w15-review, w15-chat). Runs in parallel with w15-tail (concurrency 2), each in its own worktree on 3600089; merges after w15-tail. Each item is confirmed at 3600089 (root_cause_at_head in /tmp/frbench/wave15b-triage.json and the problems above; W15-NN items also in wave15-triage.json); if one no longer fails, say so in not_done with the evidence instead of changing code. One commit per item: the failing test first at the person's boundary named in its acceptance line (a real-daemon case, a composed daemon test, a UI test, or the unit test of the function that writes the sentence), then the fix, then the siblings (validation rule 8; log what you find in new_problems). A changed route gets a real-daemon case in this area's describe block 'w15-words, wave 15 run B' appended to apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts and the fake daemon in the same commit; anything persisted is tested across a restart. Model-facing text is code: test the exact text the model receives. Every new or changed person-facing sentence follows design §5 and is listed in notes_for_other_areas with its old and new text (the merge step uses that list; w15-tail's tests may assert an old sentence). Docs: the maintainer doc section of each module changed, ADR amendments appended and dated, user-guide paragraphs where a person sees the change, CHANGELOG [Unreleased] lines appended; docs/design/core-experience.md, UPDATE-LOG, requirements.md and NEXT-SESSION.md are not edited. Validation before reporting: pnpm check, pnpm test:integration, pnpm test:e2e, the UI suite and Playwright, and a bench walk before/after for the person-facing items (stand-in model; no real model in this run). Files and regions: only this area's files[]; a shared file only in the region the run B shared_files give this area. Order: W15-56, W15-74 (+W15B-18), W15B-12, W15-66, W15-65, W15-78, W15-67, W15B-13, W15B-11, W15-57, W15-60 (+W15B-19), W15B-10, W15B-14, W15B-15, W15-86, W15-43, W15B-17, W15B-16, W15-38, W15-39, W15-72, W15-40, W15-52, W15-53. Do not touch (w15-tail's): pr-executor.ts's executeIn and folderHold; intake.ts's removed-project guard; compose.ts's wake and scheduled starts; githost-watcher.ts, commands/project.ts, session/scheduler.ts, server.ts's start route and GET /projects/:id, apps/ui project pages and SummaryTab.tsx, api-types.ts, evals/injection. Not in run B at all (run C, the owner's D1 to D4 of 2026-11-09): docs-routes.ts, loop/docs.ts, conversation/agent.ts, compose.ts's chat docsDirs, what the Start dialog promises for a task whose estimate exceeds the work budget (D4; W15-38 changes only the list form). And no logic in merge.ts, pull-requests.ts, dependent-branches.ts, budget-pause.ts or budget-card.ts. Security in every item: never weaken the hooks, the sandbox or R-lock; page, search and file text never becomes instructions; never print or store a credential; no limit that code enforces today (budgets, the wrap-up reserve, the search count, 0 refused for a session and the month) moves into words.
